title: Full Stack Engineer
description: Full Stack Engineer: Build the place 20,000 developers log into Remote (GMT+0 to GMT+4) Full-time Job Overview Every day, developers open the each::labs dashboard, grab an API key and try to get a video model running before their coffee goes cold. Whether they manage it in two minutes or twenty is up to us. At each::labs, our mission is to close the imagination gap. each::labs is one API across 600+ image, video, audio and 3D models, with routing, fallback and predictable costs built in. Behind that simple promise is a lot of product: the dashboard, the playground, the SDKs, the docs, billing, and the API itself. You'll build all of it. The role This is real full stack. One week you'll redesign how usage and costs show up on the dashboard. The next you'll chase down why one endpoint is 300ms slower than it should be. You'll ship end to end, talk to the developers who use what you build, and help decide what we build next. You'll join a small engineering team across Istanbul and San Francisco. What's On Our Desk Right Now The first five minutes. Signup → API key → first generation should feel like magic. Every step between "create account" and "my first video" is yours to question, measure and remove. Costs developers can trust. 600+ models, priced in different ways: per second, per image, per run. Developers should see exactly what they spent, on which model, and why, and the dashboard, the invoice and the API should always agree to the cent. SDKs and docs people enjoy. Typed clients that stay in sync with the API, quickstarts that work the first time, and error messages that tell you what to do next. Agents as first-class users. More and more of our traffic comes from agents, not people typing code. That means an MCP server that exposes 600+ models cleanly, docs and specs an LLM can read and act on, tool descriptions that get the right model chosen, and errors an agent can recover from without a human. Fast and boring under spiky traffic. One customer's launch can multiply our traffic in minutes. Queues, retries, provider fallback, rate limits, idempotency, and p99s that don't move. You've probably already… Owned a product developers use: a public API, an SDK, a CLI, or a dashboard people live in Designed an API other people depend on, and lived with the consequences: versioning, deprecations, the breaking change you still regret Built something that AI agents use, not just people: an MCP server, a set of tools for function calling, or an API designed so a model can find the right endpoint and recover when it fails Shipped an AI-powered feature to real users and dealt with what that involves: evals, latency, cost per request, and failures that don't throw exceptions Built or fixed something that touches money, such as metering, billing, credits or usage limits Found out why something was slow and proved it with traces, profiles or query plans Shipped to production many times a week, and been the one who got paged when it broke Talked to the people using your product and changed what got built because of it Worked with image, video or audio pipelines (a plus, not a requirement) We care about what you have built. If your tool, app or service fits, even if some of the language above doesn’t match your background, we’d like to talk. Send us a link. How You Work You're strong in a typed language on the frontend and at home on the backend. You choose tools for the problem and pick up new ones quickly. You use coding agents every day, but you've also been on the other side: you've designed what an agent sees, and you know a good tool schema is product design. You write things down: short specs, clear PR descriptions, honest postmortems. How we work You own features from idea to production to the metric that tells us whether it worked We ship small and often, behind feature flags Everyone reads support tickets and talks to customers Incidents get blameless postmortems, not blame Our stack today is React/Go/Python. Useful to know, but not a requirement. Probably not for you if… You want a ticket and a spec for everything You prefer to stay on one side of the stack Talking to users sounds like someone else's job You'd rather polish code nobody sees than fix a developer's first five minutes You've used AI to write your code but never built a product where AI is part of the experience How we hire A 30-minute conversation with Canberk (Co-founder & CTO) A 90 to 120-minute practical session: walk us through something you built, or work on a real problem with us. No algorithm puzzles. Meet the team What we offer Eligibility for stock options 25 days annual leave, plus public holidays where you live Annual salary reviews, and a bonus scheme after 6 months tied to MRR and product milestones Fully remote, ideally between GMT+0 and GMT+4 for overlap High trust, zero micromanagement. We care about outcomes, not hours. How to apply Along with your CV or LinkedIn, tell us about one of these in a few sentences: an API, SDK or developer product you built, or something people or agents use through AI (an MCP server, a tool-calling integration, an LLM feature) What's one decision you'd make differently today?

title: Web Developer (Full Stack) - Hybrid
description: We are Pegasus Airlines! We are Pegasus. We represent the new generation in Turkish aviation. With our motto: Everyone has the right to fly, we inspire our guests to travel with low fares thanks to our business model. As your digital airline, our guest-centric approach offers digital technologies and unique innovations that enhance the travel experience. Today, we operate connecting flights to more than 56 countries across Türkiye, Europe, North Africa, the Middle East, Russia, and Central Asia. We have one of the youngest fleets in the world, with 129 aircraft and an average fleet age of 5.3 years as of 2026. Are you ready to embark on your Pegasus career path as our Web Developer (Full Stack) , flight number PC-2026? Requirements Education: BS/MS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related field. Team Player: Eager to learn, with a customer-first mindset, strong communication skills, a collaborative approach, and a sense of ownership.. Experience: 2–4 years of professional web development experience, with hands-on experience in frontend development and backend/API integration. Comfortable working in mature, long-lived codebases. Frontend & Web Technologies: Good knowledge of TypeScript, JavaScript, React.js, HTML5, CSS3/SCSS, and modern web development practices. Familiarity with SPA architecture, responsive design, accessibility, and web performance. Experience with Next.js and SSR is a plus. Backend & Middleware: Experience working with REST APIs and familiarity with Java/Spring. Understanding of API design, validation, error handling, testing, and service integration. Familiarity with BFF architecture, backward compatibility, caching, authentication, and API security is a plus. Software Engineering & Architecture: Good understanding of SOLID principles, OOP, design patterns, clean code, and refactoring. Familiarity with modularization, dependency injection, and technical debt management. Frontend Ecosystem & Quality: Experience with the React ecosystem, including Redux, MUI, and design systems. Familiarity with unit, integration, and UI/E2E testing, as well as test automation. CI/CD & Engineering Practices: Proficient in Git and familiar with CI/CD workflows and Continuous Delivery. Experience with GitHub Actions, automated checks, and engineering quality gates is a plus. Performance, Reliability & Security: Basic understanding of web performance optimization, scalability, observability, production troubleshooting, and web/API security, with a willingness to learn and apply best practices. AI-Assisted Development: Hands-on experience using Claude, ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, or similar AI-powered tools for coding, testing, refactoring, and technical analysis, with the ability to review and validate AI-generated output. Agile Mindset: Agile-minded, proactive, and comfortable collaborating with Product, UX, QA, Backend, Mobile, and other engineering teams. Preferred: Familiarity with Node.js, Bun, microservices, distributed systems, cloud technologies, MCP, AI agents, or agentic software development. Experience with large-scale or high-traffic applications, particularly in travel, airline, e-commerce, or other transaction-intensive domains, is a plus. In this role, you will Build & Enhance: Develop and improve web applications with a focus on performance, reliability, maintainability, and customer experience. Contribute & Grow: Contribute to technical discussions, code reviews, engineering best practices, and continuous improvements while growing your technical skills. Collaborate & Deliver: Work closely with Product, UX, QA, Backend, Mobile, and other engineering teams to solve problems and deliver high-quality solutions. What Pegasus Airlines can offer you • Discounted domestic and international flight tickets that include first-degree family members, For a single candidate can add +1 person, Discounted flight with contracted airlines to destinations where there are no flights • Private health insurance • Food voucher • Remote and flexible working hours on certain days according to a working model, allowance for remote working days • Fun@Fly Social Activity Clubs (Social clubs such as theatre club, sailing, trekking, running, basketball, music, books, zumba, tennis, volleyball and football teams, e-sports team) • Kindergarten opportunity for female employees (Istanbul, Izmir, Antalya) • Performance-based bonus system • Shuttle Discover Pegasus Airlines! Our Framework for a Sustainable Future prioritizes our impact on the environment and society, as well as economic development. We call our route Sustainable Future. By 2050, we aim to eliminate carbon emissions from our operations, and we are working towards this goal. We are proud of a rich governance culture that is developed through a perspective open to continuous improvement and the feedback of our stakeholders. We regularly and transparently share our targets and performance on these issues with the public. Gender equality is at the foundation of our corporate culture. We are one of the pioneering airlines that have signed IATA's voluntary initiative "25by2025" to increase the representation of women in all areas of the aviation industry, including pilot, technician, and management ranks. We were the first airline in the world to join the UN Women's Empowerment Principles (WEPs) platform. Listen to every different voice in our quest for a more equal tomorrow for future generations and we call our voice #PegasusHarmony 💛

title: Product Engineer — AI-Native Full Stack
description: Product Engineer: Build the products developers and creators actually want to use Remote (GMT+0 to GMT+4) Full-time Job Overview At each::labs, we're building tools that make generative AI accessible and useful for developers, creators, and businesses. We move fast, experiment continuously, and care about turning powerful technology into products people genuinely want to use. We're looking for a product-minded engineer who uses AI as a core part of how they build, thinks beyond implementation, and takes ownership from identifying a problem to measuring its impact. What You'll Do Build products end-to-end: Turn user problems into intuitive, reliable experiences, from backend services and APIs to frontend interfaces. Develop AI-first: Use coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex to accelerate development, automate workflows, and improve how software is built, tested, and maintained. Build for developers and creators: Develop APIs, integrations, workflows, and creative tools that make complex AI capabilities simple to use. Own the user experience: Understand how people use our products through feedback, PostHog analytics, and behavioral data. Identify friction, experiment, and continuously improve. Think in outcomes: Challenge assumptions, prioritize meaningful problems, and measure success through adoption, usability, reliability, and business impact. Ship and operate: Own features through deployment, monitoring, iteration, and production support. Improve how we build: Experiment with agentic workflows, automation, and engineering practices that help the entire team deliver better software. What we're looking for Strong product engineering mindset: You care about why something should exist, who it's for, and whether it solves the problem. Full-stack capabilities: Solid experience with Go, React, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, and modern API development. AI-native development experience: Practical use of Claude Code, Codex, or similar coding agents beyond basic code generation. You know how to delegate, verify, and integrate AI-generated work. Strong engineering fundamentals: You can design maintainable systems, reason about trade-offs, test effectively, and debug production issues. User-driven decision-making: Experience using product analytics, experimentation, and customer feedback to guide improvements. Ownership and autonomy: Comfortable with ambiguity, rapid iteration, and taking responsibility for results. Clear communication: You collaborate effectively across engineering, product, and business. Experience with AWS, distributed systems, observability, and developer platforms is a plus. What Matters Here Problems over tools. Technology is a means to solve something valuable. Outcomes over output. Shipping code isn't success unless it creates value. AI as leverage. We expect you to rethink how software is developed, not simply type faster. Experience matters. Great functionality should also be intuitive and enjoyable. Ownership end-to-end. Understand the problem, build the solution, measure the result, and improve it. What we offer 25 days of annual leave, plus local public holidays. 5-day carryover within the first three months of the following year. Stock options with a 1-year cliff and 4-year vesting. Annual salary reviews and a company-wide MRR-linked bonus scheme after six months. Remote-first, ideally GMT+0 to GMT+4. A high-trust, high-ownership environment with minimal bureaucracy, no micromanagement, and real influence over the product.
